name: Working Together
overview: Scripture emphasizes the blessing and strength found in unity and cooperation among believers. Psalms 133:1 celebrates the goodness of brethren dwelling together in unity, while Proverbs 27:17 illustrates how mutual encouragement sharpens and refines one another. Ecclesiastes 4:9 highlights the practical benefits of partnership, affirming that two working together achieve greater rewards. Christ promises His presence where believers gather in His name (Matthew 18:20), and Ephesians 4:16 describes the church as a body joined and working in harmony for growth and love. Finally, Colossians 3:23 exhorts believers to serve wholeheartedly as unto the Lord, underscoring the heart behind effective collaboration.
